Rules: real_exam/TEACHING_STYLE_GUIDE.md R1-R35 (no 'which way is better' verdict) + NITZAN_RHYTHM_DELIVERY.md P1-P13. Calm preset on the question reading and plain calculations.
slides: Some word problems are really reading-comprehension tests. There's no tricky equation here, and no complicated calculation. The question just checks that we understand what we read.

slides.say: Sometimes the wording is a bit hard to follow. And sometimes they just give us a lot of information, to see if we can handle it without panicking.

Some students see a long question full of numbers and skip it. Don't. The technique is the same as always. We don't try to solve it all at once. We go step by step, one piece of information at a time.

slides: The calculations themselves are simple. What matters is noticing every detail. A price for every hundred grams, two small words like or part, and what exactly they ask. Let's see it in two questions. I'll see you in the next video.
